memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports managing tailoring work, stands for 6‑8 hours daily, no difficulty with ADLs.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal) – negative screen.
falls: denies falls in past 12 months; gait steady; timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds – normal fall risk.
medicines: 3 regular (sertraline 50 mg OD, escitalopram 10 mg OD, mirtazapine 15 mg HS); polypharmacy not present.
mood: PHQ‑9 to be sent today; reports low mood, anhedonia, guilt.
carers: husband Rajesh, spouse.
goal: "I want to feel energetic enough to enjoy my work and time with my family."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
PHQ‑9: 14 (moderately severe depression).
TSH: 2.1 mIU/L (ref 0.4‑4.0).
Vitamin B12: 210 pg/mL (ref 200‑900).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
sertraline 75 mg OD
continue escitalopram 10 mg OD
continue mirtazapine 15 mg HS

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: able to sew for 7 hours, occasional neck stiffness after long sessions.
cognition: Mini‑Cog not repeated (scheduled yearly).
falls: no new falls; gait unchanged; timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds.
medicines: 3 regular (sertraline 75 mg OD, escitalopram 10 mg OD, mirtazapine 15 mg HS); polypharmacy not present.
mood: PHQ‑9 10 (moderate); reports improved sleep, still low energy.
carers: husband Rajesh, spouse.
goal: "I hope to regain the stamina to work a full day without fatigue."

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Booked follow‑up visit with Dr Nandini Kulkarni for 2025-08-15 at 10:30 am.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: tailoring work tolerated 8 hours, mild wrist discomfort after prolonged sewing.
cognition: Mini‑Cog not due yet.
falls: no falls; gait normal; timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds.
medicines: 3 regular (sertraline 75 mg OD, escitalopram 10 mg OD, mirtazapine 15 mg HS); polypharmacy not present.
mood: PHQ‑9 8 (mild); reports better concentration, occasional irritability.
carers: husband Rajesh, spouse.
goal: "I would like to stop feeling tired after work and enjoy weekend outings."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
stop mirtazapine 15 mg HS
continue sertraline 75 mg OD
continue escitalopram 10 mg OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Vitamin B12: 180 pg/mL (ref 200‑900) – low.
TSH: 2.2 mIU/L (ref 0.4‑4.0).
PHQ‑9: 9 (mild).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Message via clinic app: "I’ve been feeling more down again, struggling to focus on intricate patterns, and I’m worried about the B12 result. Can we talk about adjusting my treatment?"

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referred to MindWell Psychology Services for cognitive‑behavioural therapy for depression. Patient prefers female therapist, available evenings. Sent summary of PHQ‑9 trends, medication list, and request for 8‑week CBT course.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Psychologist reports patient attended 6 sessions, engaged well, learned activity scheduling and thought‑record techniques. PHQ‑9 dropped from 9 to 5. Recommended continuation of CBT and mindfulness practice.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: tailoring work full day manageable, occasional lower‑back ache after standing.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 3/5 (recall 2 items, clock draw mild abnormality) – negative screen (cut‑off ≤2).
falls: no falls in past year; gait steady; timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds.
medicines: 2 regular (sertraline 75 mg OD, escitalopram 10 mg OD); polypharmacy not present.
mood: PHQ‑9 5 (mild); reports improved mood, better sleep.
carers: husband Rajesh, spouse.
goal: "I want to keep feeling steady and be able to take on more complex tailoring projects."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
PHQ‑9: 5 (mild).
TSH: 2.1 mIU/L (ref 0.4‑4.0).
Vitamin B12: 190 pg/mL (ref 200‑900) – still low; advise oral B12 500 µg OD.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Eye exam (Snellen): visual acuity 6/6 both eyes; intra‑ocular pressure 14 mmHg; fundus normal. No retinopathy or cataract changes.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Changed appointment from 2026-09-01 to 2026-08-25 at 14:00 h per patient request.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: manages tailoring shop, reports occasional hand fatigue after intricate embroidery.
cognition: Mini‑Cog not due (next scheduled 2027-04).
falls: no falls; gait normal; timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds.
medicines: 2 regular (sertraline 75 mg OD, escitalopram 10 mg OD); polypharmacy not present.
mood: PHQ‑9 4 (minimal); reports feeling well, enjoys work and family time.
carers: husband Rajesh, spouse.
goal: "I want to stay healthy and continue doing the work I love without feeling tired."
